request.objective:
The Robinhood Chain end of a LayerZero V2 bridge for NIGHTSHIFT ($SHIFT): ShiftOFT, an OFT named NIGHTSHIFT, symbol SHIFT, 18 decimals, with no supply at deployment. Total supply: 0 at deployment, then exactly the SHIFT locked in the Ethereum adapter and not yet sent back, so never more than the 1,000,000,000 SHIFT that exist on Ethereum. It mints only on a verified message from its one peer and burns on send. Its peer is fixed in the constructor: endpoint id 30101 (Ethereum), the OFT adapter at 0x1111111111111111111111111111111111111111. LayerZero EndpointV2 on this chain: 0x6F475642a6e85809B1c36Fa62763669b1b48DD5B (endpoint id 30416).

The owner and LayerZero delegate is 0x6c4c78f2c3bdf4c4318fe305fb1c8bc1694d19b5, set in the constructor. Only the owner can set the send and receive library config (DVNs and confirmations) through the endpoint as delegate, set enforced options, and lower the outbound rate limit; it cannot change the peer, mint, burn anyone's tokens, pause or upgrade. Use LayerZero V2 OApp/OFT semantics with 6 shared decimals and LayerZero's RateLimiter: at most 10,000,000 SHIFT may leave per rolling hour, which the owner can lower and never raise above 10,000,000. No fees, so nobody receives fees or payouts; no blocklist, no pause, no upgrade path, no rescue function. Plain ERC-20 transfers.

Put the LayerZero code the contract needs under src/ and add nothing under lib/. The constructor must not revert when the endpoint address holds no code, because the launch verifier's protected-invariant harness deploys the contract in a fresh EVM. Nothing is called after deployment by the deployer: the owner sets the ULN config with 2 required DVNs (LayerZero Labs and one independent DVN) and 15 block confirmations, because LayerZero's default on Robinhood Chain is its dead DVN.

Foundry tests with LayerZero's test helpers: a verified message from the peer mints exactly the amount, any other sender or endpoint id is refused, send burns, the rate limit blocks the 10,000,001st SHIFT in an hour and refills, only the owner can set config and lower the limit, nobody can mint otherwise. Verify on the Robinhood Chain explorer and Sourcify.
